decisions.evidence: Read the complete proof and contract, with the actual covering, endpoint-stability, gluing, comparison, simple-connectivity and contractibility interfaces. The base is locally path connected and the connected path-space cover is trivial. Bijection gives unique local geodesics from each basepoint. The fixed-start length estimate telescopes over a finite subdivision of any rectifiable path; taking the length-space infimum proves minimization. Endpoint stability supplies joint uniform endpoint dependence and a continuous sweep. Patchwork gives vertex-angle comparison; the midpoint cosine-sum argument and marked straightening supply vertex-to-side comparison, including degeneracies and side endpoints, and the proved criterion gives all pairs. Only after CAT(0) is established does its common-start estimate yield d(H_t(x),H_t(y))<=t d(x,y). Composition with every continuous f gives the library's contractibility definition. Nonemptiness is supplied by simple connectivity; singleton and speed-zero cases are sound. BH II.4.1 and II.4.7–4.11 and Davis I.2.7 match the complete length-space route. No AC is used in these unique constructions. Current source matches reader-post source; accept the explicit composition repair.

Read every step, contract citation and actual circle/model/covering/homotopy/globalization interface. Closed balls of radius <ell/4 have distance-preserving interval lifts; the open lifts are disjoint evenly covered sheets. Based nullhomotopy is excluded by endpoint invariance. For free homotopy, the two endpoint-track lifts differ by ell throughout, whereas a lifted final constant loop is constant by uniqueness, giving the contradiction. The winding map is well-defined, bijective by linear interpolation of lifts, and additive with the stated first-then-second concatenation convention. Independently checked the Euclidean equilateral altitude ell*sqrt(3)/6<ell/2. The circle is complete, locally CAT(0), connected and a length space, so it isolates the missing simple-connectivity hypothesis exactly. Composition with the generator rules out a contraction, and the two antipodal semicircles rule out uniqueness. Positive ell supplies all needed nonzero denominators; the construction and unique lifts use no indexed choice. Current source matches reader-post source. Accept the repair distinguishing based from free nullhomotopy.
